snippet.title: The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
One borrowed identity. Five tangled romances. Welcome to L.A.

The Fame Game II: L.A. Heartbreaker launches today, October 14, on Steam!

Developed and published by Interactive Films LLC, the game combines live-action storytelling, branching choices, and romance—with you at the center of it all.

Celebrate the launch with 15% off for a limited time: $10.19 USD, down from $11.99.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4870960/The_Fame_Game_II_LA_Heartbreaker/
